statements: DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS oliphaunt_contract CASCADE

CREATE TABLE oliphaunt_contract.projects (id integer GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, slug text NOT NULL UNIQUE, budget numeric(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (budget >= 0), labels text[] NOT NULL, metadata jsonb NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL, public_id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid())

CREATE TABLE oliphaunt_contract.events (id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, project_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES oliphaunt_contract.projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, action text NOT NULL)
CREATE FUNCTION oliphaunt_contract.audit_project() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN INSERT INTO oliphaunt_contract.events(project_id, action) VALUES (NEW.id, TG_OP); RETURN NEW; END $$
CREATE TRIGGER projects_audit AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON oliphaunt_contract.projects FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION oliphaunt_contract.audit_project()

CREATE VIEW oliphaunt_contract.project_rollup AS SELECT string_agg(slug, ',' ORDER BY id) AS slugs, sum(budget)::text AS budget, count(*)::integer AS projects FROM oliphaunt_contract.projects
